title: Cabin/Cabin Locations
wikitext:
When choosing to play [[Multiplayer]] from the main menu, or choosing "Multiplayer Options" from the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu, [[cabin]]s will spawn at different locations depending on choice of [[Farm Maps|Farm Map]] and choice of "Close" or "Separate" option in the menu.

The table below shows the placement of cabins when choosing 3 or 7 cabins respectively, for "Close" and "Separate" options.
